- Redwood ownership: Redwood Legal (cc'ed: Dev Patel) will review and provide a redline/counter. To set expectations, our typical SLA for negotiation rounds is: 
  - Initial turnaround from Redwood Legal: 2 business days for straightforward redlines; up to 5 business days for complex matters requiring exec review.
  - We'd ask Acme to allow 3 business days for your initial redline turn-in (you already met that  thanks).

Proposed explicit MAP language that I'll add to the next version: 
- "Legal Redlines (MSA/DPA/SLA)
  - Owner: Acme Legal to provide initial redlines (deliverable: marked Word doc)
  - Owner: Redwood Legal to respond with counter/redline (deliverable: redlined Word doc)
  - Target turnaround: Acme \u0014 3 business days; Redwood \u0014 2 business days (standard) / up to 5 business days if executive review required
  - Escalation: if outstanding terms remain after 2 full rounds, sales leaders to schedule a 30-minute escalation call with respective legal/exec teams

I'll update the MAP and send version 2 (MAP-updated-20260811.docx) with the milestone owner table and the target close date of 2026-08-20 (dependent on procurement/PO).

Thanks \u0014 Dev, any concerns on the proposed turnaround? Rishi / Lauren, I'll flag the procurement dependency so CS can coordinate SOC 2 docs.
